description: Implement the agreed outbound HTTP security plan for PR #675 / issue #679. Scope: global BO-managed outbound HTTP policy, dynamic HTTP credential providers referenced by connect_credentials provider sentinel strings, shared request validation, authoritative channels-boundary DNS/SSRF enforcement, Req final-step credential injection, action schema alignment, BO settings UI, and full validation. Secure defaults: action disabled until enabled, private/special-use networks blocked, URL userinfo rejected, redirects disabled, safe methods only by default.
title: [outbound-http-security] Secure BO-managed outbound HTTP requests
